authority: explicit user G46 prompt incl positive synthetic restart time, maximum two accepted physical-time steps per lineage; no ARCANA physics
fail_policy: preserve every failed artifact; gate dependent extensions NOT_RUN; independent datum/restart/G15-design continue; quotient-space diagnostics never satisfy full velocity criterion
normalization: operator action ||Kz||/(||K||F ||z||), divergence ||Bz||/(||B||F ||z||), energy zTKz/(||K||F||z||^2), C/H defect ||z-Cz||/max(||z||,1); strain/div/boundary and original residual separate; fixed thresholds 1e-10 resolve ~1e-14 rounding with 1e4 margin, energy 1e-12; no post-outcome setting

stages.before_after: call native remove_nullspace on a COPY only in original-gauge diagnostic, export deltas and residual actions; never change live solution
stages.meshes: uniform L1 small spectrum oracle, real AMR L2 coarse; optional L3 only after early gates
stages.mode_test: raw coordinate rotations, H rotations, homogeneous-C rotations; all diagnostic only; no state correction
stages.operator: native mapping/FE/introspection quadrature and actual current_constraints C; H remains topology only for reactions

stages.candidate: mass weighted representative only if exact nullity proven; near-null constrained saddle candidate separately report multiplier/work/ungauged residual, no physical promotion
stages.early_gate: exact admissible K/B kernel and compatible forcing, no non-null velocity correction; otherwise BLOCKED, no 1/2/4/8 or fine solve expansion
extension: fine forced p1,p4,p8 and datum ranks only after preceding gates
one analytical prescribed-velocity control independent of free-slip gauge

stages.checkpoint: native writer and Resume computation, solution+old+old_old, mesh, clock/history; no fabrication
stages.clock_guard: pre-run lineage receipt checked against immutable native checkpoint metadata; runtime timestep guard abort before >2 accepted positive steps
stages.manufactured_case: prescribed analytical hollow-sphere Stokes velocity, nonconstant thermal and composition initial fields, native advection/diffusion, fixed deterministic mesh; restart independent of free-slip gauge
stages.strategy: two-step baseline p1; first-step checkpoint p1; copy native checkpoint into fresh same-rank and 2/4/8-rank processes, next accepted step only
stages.units: synthetic seconds, metre shell; no ARCANA years
